Our Jelly to Milk Cleanser combines the nourishing comfort of a cleansing balm with the fresh, clean-rinsing finish of a water-based cleanser. Beginning as a rich jelly and transforming into a silky milk the moment it hits water, this barrier-first formula dissolves daily buildup while helping replenish and reinforce the moisture barrier – leaving your skin feeling cushioned, not compromised.

01 Warm cleanser between fingertips 02 Massage onto dry skin for a minute (or damp skin for a smoother glide and lighter cleanse) 03 Transform by adding water and continue massaging for a minute as it becomes a silky milk that dissolves daily buildup 04 Rinse clean with water or washcloth.
- For double cleansing, use before a Cleansing Bar or after the Cleansing Oil - For a mini-mask treatment, leave on for a few minutes before emulsifying
93% agreed their skin felt soft, hydrated, and nourished after use
93% agreed their skin felt clean without feeling stripped
94% agreed that the jelly-to-milk transformation created an enjoyable cleansing experience
Based on a consumer perception survey with 97 participants. Individual results may vary.
